welcome.title: EOL Checklist
welcome.subtitle: End-of-life Disaster Response Checklist
welcome.description: Prepare a complete information checklist for your family to help them access all important information in case of emergency.

guidedMode.title: Guided Mode
guidedMode.subtitle: Step by Step
guidedMode.description: Follow a preset order to fill in all information step by step. Ideal for first-time users or those who want to complete systematically.

freeMode.title: Free Mode
freeMode.subtitle: Your Choice
freeMode.description: Freely choose which sections to fill in. Ideal for users familiar with the checklist or those who only want to update specific information.

welcome.dataPrivacy: Your data is stored locally in your browser only and will not be uploaded to any server

manualSave.title: Manual Save
manualSave.description: Click save button to persist your data safely

export.title: Multi-format Export
export.description: Export to JSON, Markdown and more

checklist.title: EOL Checklist
checklist.emptyCategory: No items to fill in this category

completion.title: 🎉 Congratulations! You've completed all sections!
completion.description: You can preview and export your checklist, or continue editing any section.

emergency-contacts.name: Emergency Contacts
emergency-contacts.description: Contact the following friends and family directly before announcing on social media.

tech.name: Tech
tech.description: This section covers topics that will help you access my emails and website logins, plus device inheritance and tech support contacts.

input.name: Input (Income)
input.description: This is the section where money lands or exists.

output.name: Output (Expenses)
output.description: This is the section with bills and things you gotta pay. Everything is on auto-pay so no stress.

misc.name: Miscellaneous
misc.description: Other important information including financial advisors, accountants, security questions, and physical security.

contact-list.name: Contact List
contact-list.description: Notify these people in the following order before announcing on social media.
contact-list.helpText: Add contacts to notify, select their communication platform, and prioritize the order.

social-announcement.name: Social Media Announcement
social-announcement.description: After notifying close contacts, make announcements on social media.
social-announcement.helpText: List social media platforms where announcements should be made.

emails.name: Emails
emails.description: Primary email accounts. Can be accessed via phone or laptop.
emails.helpText: Add all important email account information.

domains-blogs.name: Domains and Blogs
domains-blogs.helpText: Record all domain registrars and renewal information.

password-managers.name: Password Managers
password-managers.description: Password managers are the key to accessing all other accounts.
password-managers.helpText: Record master password information. This is one of the most important pieces of information.

subscriptions.name: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: How to handle various subscription services.
subscriptions.helpText: Record all subscriptions and mark whether to keep, cancel, or transfer.

homelabs.name: Homelabs
homelabs.description: ⚠️ Important: Format or destroy drives before selling! This could lead to identity theft.
homelabs.helpText: Record all devices and their inheritors, and whether they need formatting.

wireless-network.name: Wireless Network
wireless-network.description: Wireless network devices and troubleshooting information.
wireless-network.helpText: Record network device info and who to contact when things break.

network-services.name: Network Services
network-services.helpText: Record troubleshooting steps for network issues.

home-automation.name: Home Automation/IoT
home-automation.description: If changing WiFi name (e.g., moving to ISP's built-in WiFi), these devices need reconnecting.
home-automation.helpText: Record all smart home devices for reconnection when changing networks.

social-media.name: Social Media
social-media.description: How to handle social media accounts. All can be accessed via password manager and phone's MFA app.
social-media.helpText: Record all social media accounts and how to handle them.

2fa.name: Two-Factor Authentication
2fa.description: Two-factor authentication (2FA) or multi-factor authentication (MFA) is important for account security.
2fa.helpText: Record authentication apps and backup methods.

cloud-subscriptions.name: Cloud Subscriptions
cloud-subscriptions.description: ⚠️ Very important! These bills can grow quickly.
cloud-subscriptions.helpText: Record all cloud subscriptions, especially those that may generate large bills.

online-storage.name: Online Storage
online-storage.description: Online storage and photo backup services. These contain all our memories - very important.
online-storage.helpText: Record all online storage services, especially photo backups. Don't close accounts or you'll lose photos!

local-storage.name: Local Storage
local-storage.description: Local storage devices (like NAS) contain backups and digital life you don't want on the internet.
local-storage.helpText: ⚠️ Important: If not keeping, have a professional wipe the data. Don't just throw it away!

websites.name: Websites
websites.helpText: Record all hosted websites and their renewal information.

tech-tips.name: Tech Tips
tech-tips.helpText: Record any important tech security tips.

bank-accounts.name: Bank Accounts
bank-accounts.description: We have several bank accounts for different purposes.
bank-accounts.helpText: Record all bank account information including purpose and PIN.

virtual-currency.name: Virtual Currency
virtual-currency.helpText: Record all crypto accounts and wallet information.

residual-income.name: Residual Income
residual-income.description: Passive income sources that auto-deposit to bank accounts.

investments.name: Investments
investments.description: Investment account information. Call investment companies for advice if needed.

insurance-accounts.name: Insurance Accounts
insurance-accounts.helpText: Record all insurance accounts and payment methods.

credit-cards-loans.name: Credit Cards and Loans
credit-cards-loans.helpText: Record all credit cards and loans, including auto-pay settings.

cell-phone-internet.name: Cell Phone & Internet
cell-phone-internet.description: Cell phone and internet service bills.
cell-phone-internet.helpText: Record payment information for phone and internet services.

bill-auto-pay.name: Bill Auto Pay
bill-auto-pay.description: Bills set up for automatic payment. Remember to cancel when moving.
bill-auto-pay.helpText: Record all auto-pay bills so they can be cancelled or updated when needed.

financial-advisor.name: Financial Advisor
financial-advisor.description: Financial advisor information. Contact them to learn how to invest insurance payouts.

accountant.name: Accountant
accountant.description: Accountant can help with many things. They know our financial history.
accountant.helpText: Record accountant contact information and related advice.

security-questions.name: Security Question Answers
security-questions.description: Answers to common security questions. This information is very sensitive - keep it safe.
security-questions.helpText: Record answers to common security questions for account recovery.

physical-security.name: Physical Security
physical-security.description: Physical security device passwords and combinations.
physical-security.helpText: Record passwords for safes, medicine cabinets, gun safes, etc. Very sensitive!

security-questions.first-pet: What was your first pet's name?
security-questions.fathers-middle-name: What is your father's middle name?
security-questions.mothers-maiden-name: What is your mother's maiden name?
security-questions.childhood-street: What street did you grow up on?
security-questions.first-school: What was the name of your first school?

complete.title: 🎉 Congratulations on completing the checklist!
complete.description: You have successfully completed the EOL checklist. This checklist will help your family access important information when needed.

summary.title: Completion Summary
summary.exportReminder: Please export and safely store your data for future use.

items.backup: Please export and safely store your data, multiple backups recommended
items.inform: Inform trusted family members or friends about the location of this checklist
items.update: Regularly update the checklist to ensure accuracy
items.localStorage: Your data is stored locally in your browser only, clearing browser data will result in data loss

footer.thanks: Thank you for using the EOL Checklist app
footer.wish: May this checklist help your family ❤️

empty.title: No Content Yet
empty.description: You haven't filled in any content yet. Please return to the edit page to start filling in your checklist.

import.error: Import failed: Invalid or corrupted file format

clear.description: Permanently delete all filled data and progress. This action cannot be undone.
